body:
## Quick answer

You can buy Indian clothes online from **Bahe Kurtiz** in Jaipur and have them shipped to the **UK, USA, Canada, UAE and Australia** with **free express shipping and duties included** – nothing to pay on delivery. Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and arrive about 5–10 business days later; any style can be stitched to your measurements for free. See delivery times for every country on our [international shipping page](/international-shipping/).

## Indian ethnic wear, straight from Jaipur

Living abroad should not mean waiting for a trip home to buy Indian clothes. Bahe Kurtiz makes every piece in our own Jaipur unit and ships it directly to you.

## Shop by country

Questions? [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886).

## Country guide

### USA

**Sizes:** US dress sizes convert by bust: US 8 is about a 36-inch bust (an Indian M). Use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) or choose free custom fit.

**What to wear:** The USA spans every climate, so pick by season: breathable cotton and georgette for summer weddings in Texas, Florida or California, and velvet or taffeta with a warm layer for winter weddings and Diwali in New York, New Jersey or Chicago.

**Festivals:** Indian weddings in the USA cluster in the warm months, and Diwali is celebrated at home, in temples and increasingly at work. Office Diwali parties need something festive but easy – see our [Diwali office party guide](/blog/diwali-party-outfits-for-the-office-usa-uk/).

**Price:** Shown in US dollars; your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts to US dollars – no conversion needed.

- [What to wear to an Indian wedding in the USA](/blog/what-to-wear-to-an-indian-wedding-in-the-usa/)
- [Indian outfits for work in the USA](/blog/indian-outfits-for-work-in-the-usa/)
- [Kurta sets for women in the USA](/indian-kurta-sets-for-women-usa/)
- [Indian wedding guest outfits – the complete guide](/indian-wedding-guest-outfits/)

### UK

**Sizes:** UK dress sizes are 4 higher than US sizes: UK 12 is about a 36-inch bust (an Indian M). The [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) has a UK option, or choose free custom fit.

**What to wear:** British weather means layers for most of the year: velvet or taffeta Anarkalis for winter weddings and Diwali, thermals under straight pants, and a long coat or shawl over the dupatta. In summer, cotton and georgette are enough.

**Festivals:** Big Diwali celebrations take place in cities such as Leicester and London, and Vaisakhi is celebrated by Sikh communities across the UK every April. Indian weddings run all year, with many in the summer.

**Price:** Shown in US dollars; your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts to pounds.

- [What to wear to an Indian wedding in the UK](/blog/what-to-wear-to-an-indian-wedding-in-the-uk/)
- [How to layer Indian outfits in winter abroad](/blog/how-to-layer-indian-outfits-in-winter-abroad/)
- [Holi outfits for cold weather in the UK and Canada](/blog/holi-outfits-for-cold-weather-uk-and-canada-2027/)
- [Indian wedding guest outfits – the complete guide](/indian-wedding-guest-outfits/)

### Canada

**Sizes:** Canada uses US dress sizes: size 8 is about a 36-inch bust (an Indian M). Use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) or choose free custom fit.

**What to wear:** Canadian winters are cold, so winter weddings and Diwali call for velvet or taffeta with thermals, closed shoes and a warm coat. Summer weddings in Toronto, Brampton or Vancouver can be hot – choose cotton or light georgette.

**Festivals:** Large Punjabi and Gujarati communities in the Greater Toronto Area and British Columbia mean busy summer wedding seasons, Navratri garba nights in the autumn and Vaisakhi parades every spring.

**Price:** Shown in US dollars; your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts to Canadian dollars.

- [What to wear to an Indian wedding in Canada](/blog/what-to-wear-to-an-indian-wedding-in-canada/)
- [What to wear to a Punjabi wedding](/blog/what-to-wear-to-a-punjabi-wedding-as-a-guest/)
- [How to layer Indian outfits in winter abroad](/blog/how-to-layer-indian-outfits-in-winter-abroad/)
- [Indian wedding guest outfits – the complete guide](/indian-wedding-guest-outfits/)

### Australia

**Sizes:** Australian dress sizes follow UK sizes: AU 12 is about a 36-inch bust (an Indian M). The [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) has an AU option, or choose free custom fit.

**What to wear:** The seasons are reversed: Diwali falls in spring and Christmas in summer, so light cotton and georgette suit most festivals. Velvet is only worth it for winter weddings from June to August, especially in Melbourne.

**Festivals:** Diwali festivals take place in Sydney, Melbourne and other cities every year, and many Indian weddings are held in the warm months from October to April.

**Price:** Shown in US dollars; your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts to Australian dollars.

- [What to wear to an Indian wedding in Australia](/blog/what-to-wear-to-an-indian-wedding-in-australia/)
- [Destination wedding outfits](/blog/destination-wedding-outfits-goa-udaipur-jaipur/)
- [Linen vs cotton dresses for hot weather](/blog/linen-vs-cotton-dresses-which-is-better-for-hot-weather/)
- [Indian wedding guest outfits – the complete guide](/indian-wedding-guest-outfits/)

### UAE

**Sizes:** Shops in the UAE use mixed size systems. Compare your bust in inches with our size chart or use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) – or choose free custom fit.

**What to wear:** For most of the year it is hot outside and air-conditioned inside: breathable cotton and lined georgette or chiffon work well, with a light dupatta for cool halls. Modest cuts with full sleeves suit many functions.

**Festivals:** Indian weddings in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah are often planned in the cooler months, and both Eid and Diwali are big celebrations for the community.

**Price:** Shown in US dollars; your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts to dirhams.

- [Indian wedding guest outfits in Dubai and Abu Dhabi](/blog/indian-wedding-guest-outfits-in-dubai-and-abu-dhabi/)
- [Eid outfit ideas abroad](/blog/eid-outfit-ideas-anarkali-and-kurta-sets-abroad/)
- [Modest wedding guest outfits](/blog/modest-hijabi-indian-wedding-guest-outfits/)
- [Indian wedding guest outfits – the complete guide](/indian-wedding-guest-outfits/)

### Singapore

**Sizes:** Singapore shops use mixed size systems. Compare your bust in inches with our size chart or use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) – or choose free custom fit.

**What to wear:** Singapore is hot and humid all year, with strong air-conditioning indoors: breathable cotton, kota doria and lined georgette, plus a light dupatta, are the most comfortable choices.

**Festivals:** Deepavali is a public holiday in Singapore, and Little India comes alive for the festival every year. Weddings and pujas take place all year round.

**Price:** Shown in US dollars; your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts to Singapore dollars.

- [What to wear to a Tamil wedding](/blog/what-to-wear-to-a-tamil-wedding-as-a-guest/)
- [Temple and puja outfits abroad](/blog/temple-and-puja-outfits-for-women-abroad/)
- [Kota doria fabric guide](/blog/kota-doria-fabric-guide/)
- [Indian wedding guest outfits – the complete guide](/indian-wedding-guest-outfits/)

### Malaysia

**Sizes:** Malaysian shops use mixed size systems. Compare your bust in inches with our size chart or use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) – or choose free custom fit.

**What to wear:** It is hot and humid all year, so choose breathable cotton, kota doria and lined chiffon or georgette, with three-quarter sleeves and looser fits.

**Festivals:** Deepavali is a public holiday in most of Malaysia, and Thaipusam is celebrated in several states – both are busy times for the Tamil and wider Indian community.

**Price:** Shown in US dollars; your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts to ringgit.

- [What to wear to a Tamil wedding](/blog/what-to-wear-to-a-tamil-wedding-as-a-guest/)
